versions.subject: fix: typo in modifier name
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
        - '\UsageLogs\cmstp.exe.log'
        - '\UsageLogs\cscript.exe.log'
        - '\UsageLogs\mshta.exe.log'
        - '\UsageLogs\msxsl.exe.log'
        - '\UsageLogs\regsvr32.exe.log'
        - '\UsageLogs\rundll32.exe.log'
        - '\UsageLogs\svchost.exe.log'
        - '\UsageLogs\wscript.exe.log'
        - '\UsageLogs\wmic.exe.log'
filter_rundll:
    # This filter requires the event to be enriched by additional information such as ParentImage and CommandLine activity
    ParentImage|endswith: '\MsiExec.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: ' -Embedding'
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'Temp'
        - 'zzzzInvokeManagedCustomActionOutOfProc'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: TargetFilename IN ("*\\UsageLogs\\cmstp.exe.log", "*\\UsageLogs\\cscript.exe.log", "*\\UsageLogs\\mshta.exe.log", "*\\UsageLogs\\msxsl.exe.log", "*\\UsageLogs\\regsvr32.exe.log", "*\\UsageLogs\\rundll32.exe.log", "*\\UsageLogs\\svchost.exe.log", "*\\UsageLogs\\wscript.exe.log", "*\\UsageLogs\\wmic.exe.log") NOT (ParentImage="*\\MsiExec.exe" ParentCommandLine="* -Embedding*" Image="*\\rundll32.exe" CommandLine="*Temp*" CommandLine="*zzzzInvokeManagedCustomActionOutOfProc*")
